metadata.description: Arena phone harness. Drives the built app in real headless Chrome at 400x860 against canned GraphQL, and exits NON-ZERO naming the route and the reason when a page does not render, a scroller is degenerate or clips what it cannot scroll, content is unreachable, something overflows sideways, or a control is missing, unpainted, unhittable, clipped by an ancestor, or present-but-unchecked. NEEDS: a Chrome binary at /usr/bin/google-chrome, puppeteer from node_modules, and a current `nx build web` (it serves dist/web/browser). Screenshots go OUTSIDE the repo: ARENA_HARNESS_OUT, else a temp directory. CI, RECOMMENDED AND DELIBERATELY NOT WIRED (the user's call, not a developer's): make it BLOCKING for changes under web/src/app/pages/arena/, the four *.shell.ts and terminal.page.*, and ADVISORY elsewhere - a browser job that blocks everything gets disabled within a month, and then this evidence evaporates exactly the way it nearly did in a reports folder. STANDING RISK: this script is the only thing proving a human can reach the promote button on a phone, it has no tests of its own, and in the round that reviewed it two of three findings were defects in the harness rather than in the product. Check that the falsifications still FAIL before trusting a green run; they are listed at the top of the file.
